summary: A live Ausca Agent Inbox lease was discovered, challenged over x402, paid with 0.05 USDC on Base, used to receive and read a real verification email, validated against the expected subject and nonce, and explicitly deleted. The observations below contain measured timings and identifiers while excluding lease capabilities and the sender's private address.

observations.result: Fetched https://ausca.com/skills/agent-inbox/SKILL.md and https://ausca.com/openapi.yaml; the catalog exposed offer inbox.receive and the exact bindings above, but it lacked a runnable fallback for a local runx installation with no receipt signer or hosted provider grant.
POST /v1/open-inbox without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE returned HTTP 402 with x402 v2, amount 50000 atomic USDC units, network eip155:8453, and payTo 0x26572ff23c6c52bfb1a69cb0c9114a8be443b422.
Payer 0x168aBEA059DE879F44d09E5c33E2BC6318b2ff94 settled 0.05 USDC in Base transaction 0xe4c5df45f3a8b23436ba0775102932616a09b3c3923403d156858c341cf17827.

The signed POST returned HTTP 200 JSON with status=accepted, invocation object, inspect_url, and resource_access. Invocation paid_c9aa98d1-1929-493d-af61-5f1d0ac78a6e was already succeeded and created a one-hour inbox lease.
Not applicable: inbox.receive completed synchronously in the signed HTTP 200 response, so no invocation polling was required.
A real email was manually sent from an account controlled by the operator and Ausca recorded it under the message identifier above. This elapsed time includes the human send step.
GET /messages?wait_seconds=30 returned one normalized summary with the expected subject, recipient, ingress timestamp, and zero attachments.
GET /messages/{message_id} returned the normalized body. The subject and verification ID gofrantic-135-20260917 matched the sent message.

Retrieved the result through the lease access and validated offer/revision/schema bindings, invocation state succeeded, output digest, recipient, subject, nonce, and attachment count. No untrusted HTML was rendered.
The public RunX page identified Ausca and successful Agent Inbox completion, but its visible summary did not expose the settled amount or full binding details.
DELETE /v1/agent-inboxes/{inbox_id} returned deleted; a subsequent status read independently confirmed state=deleted and the same deleted_at timestamp.
Total elapsed from the paid request start through independently verified deletion was 10 minutes 9.386 seconds, including the operator's manual email send.

issues.issue: The documented runx x402-pay path could not execute locally because runx-cli 0.6.15 had neither a receipt signer nor a hosted provider grant. The official Coinbase x402 client completed the same challenge successfully, but the skill did not provide a fallback decision tree for this state.

The Node x402 client initially failed before signing because globalThis.crypto was unavailable in the runtime. Wiring node:crypto webcrypto fixed it, but the package error did not identify that remediation.

The public receipt page is L1 hash-only: it showed Ausca and completion but not the 0.05 USD settlement or exact bindings. Its advertised alternate JSON URL /v1/receipts/notarizations/38ed133b4da18f4d940e911b58598343773cda0579898639cf9cf6ee2d73f146 returned HTTP 404, and submitting this official receipt public_url to GoFrantic preflight returned HTTP 500 while evidence_json and report preflighted normally in isolation.

proposed_change: Add an executable Node example to the Agent Inbox skill that initializes node:crypto webcrypto, handles the unsigned 402 and signed retry, and prints a redacted verification checklist containing payment amount, offer bindings, invocation ID, output digest, and receipt URL.
